name: path
label: Path
help: Where the file goes in the bucket, with its name, for example `videos/launch.mp4`.

name: size
label: Size (bytes)
help: The size of the file in bytes.

name: contentType
label: MIME type
help: The MIME type, for example `application/pdf`. Leave it empty and the storage provider stores a generic type.

name: conflict
label: If the name is taken
help: What to do when a file with this path exists: "Fail" stops with an error, "Rename" uploads it as "name (1)", and "Replace" overwrites it at the storage provider. Nubbo keeps no copy of the old file; a bucket with versioning keeps it as an older version.

name: multipart
label: Multipart upload
help: Upload in parts even when the file is smaller than 5 GB (parts start at 5 MiB). Files above 5 GB always upload in parts.
